home.storageUnavailable: Mnemo works best when storage is available. Some browsers block this in private mode.
home.empty: Nothing here yet. Start with one thought - anything you'd want to find a year from now.

firstResurfacing.message_one: In {{count}} day, your first thought returns.
firstResurfacing.message_other: In {{count}} days, your first thought returns.
firstResurfacing.empty: Save your first thought - it will return in 7 days.

dailyPrompt.label: Spark
prompts: What did you learn today that you'd want to remember?
What surprised you this week?
What would you want to find here a year from now?
What decision are you facing right now?
What are you afraid of losing?
What has changed in you recently?
What do you keep coming back to?
What did you almost say, but didn't?
What do you want to remember about today?
What is pulling your attention right now?
What belief of yours has shifted lately?
What would your future self thank you for noticing?
What is something you understood differently today?
What are you holding onto that you might need to release?
What made you feel most like yourself recently?
What question keeps coming back to you?
What do you know now that you didn't know a month ago?
What are you becoming?
What would you regret not writing down?
What is quietly true about your life right now?
What are you grateful for that you haven't said out loud?
What has been harder than you expected?
What has been easier than you expected?
What do you want to remember about this phase of your life?
What are you pretending not to know?
What small thing has mattered more than expected?
What conversation changed something in you?
What have you been avoiding thinking about?
What do you stand for right now?
What is the most honest thing you could write today?

capture.title: New fragment
capture.saved: Saved. It will return when the time is right.

unsaved.title: Unsaved fragment
unsaved.message: You haven't saved this fragment yet. Save it, or start a new one?

unsavedAudio.title: Transcribe and save first
unsavedAudio.message: Transcribe this recording and save it before starting a new fragment. Or discard it and begin again.

record.notSupported: Audio recording isn't supported in this browser.
record.instruction: Tap the microphone to record up to 30 seconds.
record.transcriptHint: Edit the transcript before saving if needed.

archive.title: Archive
archive.empty: Your archive is empty. Every fragment you save will live here.

resurface.explanation_one: This fragment surfaced because you wrote it {{count}} day ago.
resurface.explanation_other: This fragment surfaced because you wrote it {{count}} days ago.
resurface.notDueYet: This fragment isn't due to surface yet.

fragmentItem.removeConfirm: Remove this fragment? This cannot be undone.

login.successBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to enter Mnemo.

errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

intro.title: A grid for your weeks
intro.body: Each square is a day. Colour tells the story of how you felt. Pick your palette - six colours, one per emotion. You can change them later from your Profile.

choose.title: Choose your colours
choose.body: Tap a circle for each emotion. The selected one stays highlighted.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Here's how your grid will look with the colours you picked.
